checks.name: Durable desired settings alone cannot confirm application
Pending result keeps candidate identity and saved revision separate
Exact existing model acknowledgement and actual configuration confirm this save
A retained different entry cannot confirm the new candidate
A different fixed exit cannot confirm the candidate
Unaccepted browser policy cannot borrow a network acknowledgement
A newer desired candidate retires an old save success
Old applied revision cannot satisfy a newer candidate
Only the new candidate accepts its exact new application revision
Reused slot with different stable identity cannot borrow a receipt
A new environment generation retires the old acknowledgement
Receipt capture rejects mismatched model identity
Receipt capture rejects a model that mirrors a different candidate
A core-only or unopened-session result never claims webpage application
Cancelled candidate is never displayed as still pending
A superseded operation preserves its own candidate and version
Published JSON cannot mutate the frozen operation receipt
Public result contains no raw configuration or source payload
Failed save has no saved or applied revision
Failure to read the model after durable save never becomes save failed
Uncertain durable storage is not mislabeled saved or failed
A superseded save with unavailable version is still distinct from failed

scope: Actual EnvironmentSpec and NetworkApplicationReceipt methods. Runtime admission, Android lifecycle and real core verification are not exercised.
